216	### quant-ml-canon-meta-label-gate (priority 2)
217	
218	**technique.** Meta-labelling: a secondary model over the Foundation primary model, trained on triple-barrier and intraday label variants with return-attribution (|net|) sample weights, uniqueness weights where labels overlap, optional time decay; bagged depth-limited trees and a depth-3 interaction-constrained gradient booster as ceilings, a binned logistic scorecard as the deployable form, distilled to a rule list of at most 8 depth-3 rules.
219	
220	**what_it_answers.** Given that Foundation already chose side and entry, what is P(the trade pays after costs | as-of context) at the SETUP bar, which SETUPs should be skipped, and does a gate trained to preserve the large winners (the user's 'avoid only loss trades') beat the frozen ST7/ST8 rooms gate and the session-matched random control on kept-vs-skipped expectancy, on IS out-of-fold and once on OOS? Also: which label (engine, intraday, symmetric barrier, trend-scanning) yields the most robust gate.
221	
222	**method.** Inputs: features.parquet per timeframe through an allowlist of as-of columns (97 numeric plus one-hot or count encodings of fz_read, fz_gate, fz_block_reason, fz_branch, dir, hv3_dir, card_out_side, last_bos_dir, last_choch_dir, last6_kinds); bars.parquet to recompute labels. Labels, all from bars after the SETUP bar: L0 = the engine net as built (multi-session holds); L1 = Foundation intraday: the same stop / next-CHoCH exit but forced out at the close of the entry session's last bar opening at or before 15:25, priced as the lab does (lab.trade_charges ZERODHA_NFO_FUT on slipped prices, 5 pts per side, lot 65); L2 = symmetric triple barrier: lower barrier = the Foundation stop, upper barrier = entry + 1 x stop distance (and 2 x as a variant), vertical = 15:25, first-touch with the engine's same-bar conventions (stop first, a session's first candle fills at its close); L3 = trend-scanning: for horizons 5..60 bars the t-value of the OLS slope of close after the SETUP, label = sign and |t| at the horizon of maximum |t| relative to dir (the 'large move' the user describes). Primary training label = L1 binary (net > 0); L0/L2/L3 are robustness labels, every gate is evaluated on L1 because that is the book ST13/ST14 will trade (square_off 15:25). Weights: w_i proportional to |net_i| (return attribution), normalised to sum n; class balance by reweighting the 22% winners; time decay c in {1, 0.5} as a sensitivity (study 6 decides whether it is needed); average uniqueness computed from the concurrency of label lifetimes (expected 1.0 for L0/L1 since no Foundation trades overlap; below 1 for L2/L3 with vertical barriers) and used as BaggingClassifier max_samples. Models: (a) BaggingClassifier of DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth 3-5, min_weight_fraction_leaf 0.05, class_weight balanced), 300 estimators; (b) HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_depth 3, max_iter <= 200, learning_rate 0.05, l2_regularization, interaction_cst = the feature clusters from the importance study, monotonic_cst where the hypothesis states a direction); (c) binned logistic scorecard: KBinsDiscretizer (quantile, 4-6 bins) on at most 12 shortlisted features, L1-penalised LogisticRegression, coefficients rounded to integer points. Protocol: the harness splitter (12 blocks, purge by L-specific exit bar, 3-session embargo), nested choice of the skip threshold tau in {0.10, ..., 0.40} inside each training fold by maximising kept expectancy subject to |net|-weighted winner recall >= 0.90; OOF probabilities saved per model and label (consumed by the conformal and sizing studies). IS-OOF evaluation per model: kept net, skipped net, kept-vs-skipped mean difference and permutation p, precision/recall on losers, share of top-decile winners skipped, control percentile from fz_report.random_control on the kept positions per session, CPCV path distribution. Distillation: fit a depth-3 tree and a greedy rule list (<= 8 conjunctive rules, depth <= 3, features from the importance shortlist, thresholds at quantile grid points) to the OOF decision p_win >= tau (not to the labels), report fidelity, re-run the full evaluation with the rule list alone; log every distillation trial in the harness ledger. Freeze: the rule-list JSON, the scorecard JSON and tau with sha, before OOS. OOS once: the frozen rule list, the frozen scorecard, the frozen ST7/ST8 gate and raw Foundation, same table. Also state explicitly why RL is not used: one-step decision, counterfactual observed for every SETUP, no overlap.
223	
224	**leakage_controls.** Feature allowlist excludes fwd_*, fnd_*, fzpos_*, fzpost_* and every final-state column (swing broken flags, room retirement, visit end fields); verified by re-scoring the truncated build (trunc_20250630_120000) and asserting identical predictions for SETUPs before the cut. Labels are recomputed from bars strictly after setup_i and stored in a separate file. Purge by the label's own exit bar, 3-session embargo, thresholds chosen inside training folds only, OOF predictions never reused for training the same model; calibration and conformal quantiles downstream use OOF only. OOS touched once through the frozen JSON; the label variant used for the OOS table is fixed in advance (L1). Charges and slippage in the label so that the gate cannot win by cost avoidance alone; the kept-vs-skipped statistic is the selection criterion, never net.
225	
226	**compute.** Label recomputation from bars: numpy, under 30 s per timeframe. 12 folds x 3 models x 4 labels x 2 weight schemes = 288 fits; bagging 300 trees on <= 5k x 100 about 3-6 s, HGB about 2 s, scorecard under 1 s: 15-25 CPU-minutes per timeframe with n_jobs = 2; CPCV adds about 10 minutes when requested by the harness; peak memory under 400 MB (the feature table is under 10 MB).
227	
228	**libraries.** numpy, pandas, scipy; sklearn 1.7.2: BaggingClassifier, DecisionTreeClassifier, HistGradientBoostingClassifier (interaction_cst and monotonic_cst confirmed present), LogisticRegression, KBinsDiscretizer; joblib; lab.trade_charges and fz_report.random_control / permutation_p imported read-only (no repo writes).
229	
230	**output_as_config.** A "gate" block keyed by design timeframe for ST13 (minute) / ST14 (5minute), in the style of the fz block with value/source per key: {"model": "rule_list", "label": "foundation_intraday_1525", "rules": [{"if": [["n_choch_since_bos", ">=", 2], ["hour", "<", 13]], "then": "skip"}, ... at most 8, each at most 3 comparisons], "default": "take"} and, for the scorecard variant, {"scorecard": {"bins": {feature: [cut points]}, "points": {feature: [ints]}, "skip_if_score_below": s}}, plus "square_off": "15:25" and provenance {"study", "is_window": "2021-10-01..2025-12-31", "script", "sha", "trials", "fidelity"}. The lab side holds only a generic evaluator (AND of comparisons on named feature columns; a bin-and-sum scorecard), no number. The bagged forest and the booster are reported as the ceiling and never shipped.
231	
232	**novelty.** Lopez de Prado, AFML (2018) ch. 3 (triple-barrier method, meta-labelling), ch. 4 (label uniqueness, return attribution, time decay), ch. 6 (bagging with average uniqueness); Machine Learning for Asset Managers (2020) section 3.4 (trend-scanning labels); Joubert (2022) Meta-Labeling: Theory and Framework, J. Financial Data Science, and Meyer, Barziy and Joubert (2023) on meta-labelling architectures, which are the current practice for 'should I act on this rule-based signal'; cost-in-label and rule-list distillation are the lab's own constraints.
233	
234	**Judge 1** feasible 5 · rigour 4 · expected value 3 · keep True — fix: Trap: |net| return-attribution weights on a 15-22% win rate with top-decile winners carrying ~46% of gross turn the training set into ~30-50 outlier trades per timeframe; the nested constraint 'winner recall >= 0.90' is decided on ~15 winners per 5m fold (+-0.1 noise); 4 labels x 2 weightings x 3 models is 24 hypotheses for one question. Fix: winsorise weights at the training-fold p95 of |net| (or use sqrt), publish every kept-vs-skipped number also with the top 1% of winners removed and require the rule to win both ways, choose tau on pooled OOF with a coarse grid, train on L1 only (L0/L2/L3 as one robustness table, never as candidates), merge with study 13 into a single trial family under the harness splitter, and ship only the distilled rule list or scorecard, judged by its own CPCV 5th percentile (not the forest's).
235	
236	**Judge 2** feasible 5 · rigour 4 · expected value 4 · keep True — fix: Merge with decision-making-1 (same reward, same HGB-with-|net|-weights learner) into one script that also carries DM-1's exact depth-limited policy tree; the two studies are near-duplicates and would double the ledger. Winsorise the |net| sample weights at the IS 99th percentile before normalising: on 1m the top-decile winners are 46% of gross wins and ~70 rows, so an unwinsorised weight lets a handful of trades set the model. State the double weighting (|net| x class balance) once and run it as one scheme, keeping the time-decay c=0.5 variant only if the regime-breaks study finds a break inside IS. Report the nested-tau winner-recall constraint as a CPCV path distribution (5th percentile), because each fold has ~57 winners on 1m and ~15 on 5m; on 5m the 12-feature scorecard (48-72 bins on 184 positives) must be cut to <= 6 features. Write the L1 (15:25) label file first and share it with every other study; it is the only training label. Fits: 288 x <= 6 s = 15-25 min, < 400 MB: runs now.

326	### decision-making-1-fullinfo-bandit-policy-tree-gate (priority 1)
327	
328	**technique.** Offline contextual bandit with full-information rewards, solved as cost-sensitive policy learning: value-maximising depth-limited policy trees (Athey-Wager / Zhou-Athey-Wager) and cost-proportionate weighted gradient boosting, with the policy value computed exactly (direct method, no IPS) and distilled to a rule list
329	
330	**what_it_answers.** Which Foundation SETUPs to take and which to skip, by regime / time / volume / level / card context, chosen to maximise INR value (not accuracy), and whether the learned gate beats the session-matched random gate and the frozen ST7/ST8 gates on kept-vs-skipped expectancy rather than by trading less.
331	
332	**method.** Inputs: fz_v3/minute/setup_features.parquet (5,326 rows, 118 as-of columns) and fz_v3/5minute/features.parquet (1,012 rows, 143 as-of columns). Reward table per SETUP: r_take = fnd_net (primary variant recomputed from bars with a 15:25 square-off on the entry session, stop as hard floor; secondary = the engine's own exit as built), r_skip = 0. Every gate pi has exact value V(pi) = mean(pi(x) * r_take); baselines: Foundation (pi = take), ST7/ST8 (st7_traded / fzpos_kind), session-matched random at the same per-session count. Learners on IS only: (A) exact depth-1 and greedy depth-2/3 policy trees whose split criterion is the policy value (sum of r_take over the take-leaf), min leaf 100 SETUPs (1m) / 40 (5m), implemented in numpy over ~110 features x 30 quantile thresholds; (B) HistGradientBoostingClassifier on y = sign(net) with sample_weight = |net| winsorised at the 1st/99th percentile (Zadrozny-Langford-Abe cost-proportionate reduction; with two arms and full information this is the regret-optimal reduction), policy = take iff P_w(win) > 0.5, plus HistGradientBoostingRegressor on winsorised net with policy take iff E[net|x] > tau, tau swept post hoc from out-of-fold predictions; (C) distillation: fit a depth-<=3 DecisionTreeClassifier (min leaf 100) to (B)'s out-of-fold decisions and extract <= 8 conjunctive rules; report fidelity to (B) and the distilled policy's own CV value. Diagnostics: SHAP (TreeExplainer) on (B) for the drivers; winner recall and loser precision; per-hour and per-regime kept share. OOS once: kept n, kept net, skipped net, expectancy difference, winner recall / loser precision, random-control percentile at matched per-session k (2,000 seeded draws), permutation p, calibration of E[net|x] by decile.
333	
334	**leakage_controls.** Features restricted to the README's as-of columns; the ledger's session-so-far fields (today_net_asof etc.) are allowed because they use exits <= k. Excluded by name: fnd_*, fwd_*, fzpos_*, st7_outcome_gate and all st7_ POST columns, swings.broken_final, events.window_end/end, zones.retired_* and visits.end_* unless bar-conditioned. CV = 8 contiguous session blocks (GroupKFold on session_i, blocks kept in time order), purge = drop training SETUPs whose trade exit date falls inside the test block, embargo = 2 sessions after each test block. tau, tree depth, min-leaf and the kept-share floor are fixed above; any change is a new pre-registration. OOS evaluated exactly once with the frozen rule list; the winsorisation and quantile thresholds are computed on the training folds only.
335	
336	**compute.** HistGB on 4.5k x 110: ~2 s per fit; 8 folds x 2 learners x 3 seeds ~ 2 min; exact depth-1 policy search 110 x 30 thresholds trivial, greedy depth-3 ~ 1 min; SHAP seconds; controls (2,000 draws x 1,026 sessions) ~ 1 min. Total < 10 CPU-min per timeframe, peak memory < 400 MB.
337	
338	**libraries.** numpy, pandas, pyarrow, scikit-learn 1.7.2 (HistGradientBoosting, DecisionTree, GroupKFold), shap 0.49.1, numba (optional for the threshold sweep)
339	
340	**output_as_config.** strategy_13.json / strategy_14.json block "gate": {"kind": "rule_list", "default": "take"|"skip", "rules": [{"if": {"reg_n_choch_since_bos": [">=", 2], "hour_bin": ["in", ["11","12"]]}, "then": "skip"}, ...] (<= 8 rules, <= 3 conditions each), "min_expected_net_inr": tau, "provenance": {"source": "learned on IS 2021-10..2025-12", "script": "<name>", "sha": "<sha>", "cv_kept_minus_skipped_inr": ..., "control_pct": ...}}. 341
